purpose: Reduce the immediately recognizable cloned-leaf-card failure mode in the generated six-tree fallback while preserving the biologically connected branch/twig hierarchy, PBR foliage optics and deterministic LOD identity. This source contract awards zero Visual Fidelity points; native 3840x2160 rendered evidence remains authoritative.

biologicalReasoning.assembly: twig/secondary branch -> explicit leaf cluster -> two-sided leaf lamina geometry
biologicalReasoning.dimensionsThickness: The existing leaf lamina thickness model is preserved. Derived variants change individual lamina width/length only within approximately -10%/+10%, orientation by small angles and attachment center by centimeter-order offsets; they do not create slab-like leaves.
biologicalReasoning.materialFinish: Leaf optics remain the dry living thin-dielectric materials governed by foliage_optical_physicality_contract.json. Morphology generation does not paint highlights, change metallic/specular values, add emission or bake lighting into albedo.
biologicalReasoning.mounting: Every morphology mesh remains assigned to the pre-existing LeafCluster transform attached to explicit twig/branch construction; no gameplay collider, tree placement or trunk/branch transform is altered.
biologicalReasoning.interfacesGapsSeals: Natural assembly has no manufactured seals. The required interface is continued branch/twig attachment with no floating cluster introduced by this pass.
biologicalReasoning.orientationExposure: Small deterministic per-leaf pitch/yaw/roll differences represent natural phyllotactic and petiole-angle variation while remaining subordinate to the cluster transform and coherent midsummer Japanese sun/sky lighting.
biologicalReasoning.aging: No damage or aging is synthesized by morphology. Ordinary midsummer foliage variation is optical/material-side; storm, breakage, disaster and reconstruction cues are prohibited.

geometryVsMaterialDetail.forbiddenShortcut: Do not paint silhouette variation, sun highlights, contact shadows, holes or damage into albedo to imitate geometric diversity.

sourceLibrary.derivation: Each derived mesh starts from one of the three explicit two-sided leaf-spray masters. Per contiguous eight-vertex lamina, deterministic bounded width/length/depth scaling, pitch/yaw/roll and centimeter-order center offset are applied; UV topology is preserved and normals/tangents are recalculated.
sourceLibrary.determinism: Variant assignment is a stable integer function of tree index and parsed LeafCluster ordinal. Seven is coprime to twelve, so consecutive source ordinals traverse the full morphology library before repeating.

lodPolicy.identityRule: For any LeafCluster ordinal retained by a lower LOD, the generated morphology mesh must be exactly the same asset as the corresponding LOD0/source ordinal. LOD may remove clusters by physical scale but may not substitute a different leaf silhouette for a retained ordinal.

hardFailRules: fewer than twelve deterministic morphology assets are available after the build pass
a generated tree uses fewer than ten distinct morphology variants in source/LOD0 foliage
one exact morphology variant is used more than four times in source/LOD0 foliage of a generated tree
a retained LOD proxy changes morphology mesh for the same LeafCluster ordinal
a morphology mesh loses complete UV0, normals or tangents
a morphology mesh contains invalid/non-positive bounds or malformed two-sided leaf topology
morphology processing changes gameplay colliders, trunk/branch placement or tree placement
foliage material is made metallic/emissive or receives painted/baked highlights
source diversity checks are represented as rendered Visual Fidelity evidence

reviewFor: no immediately obvious cloned leaf-spray silhouette across neighboring clusters
no unnatural starburst or uniformly fanned leaf orientation
no metallic/plastic foliage flash under grazing sun
no severe leaf-edge aliasing or specular shimmer
no morphology swap/pop through LOD cross-fades
natural midsummer crown silhouette at hero framing

limitations: Twelve deterministic source morphologies reduce exact clone repetition but do not prove that repeated silhouettes are visually imperceptible from benchmark cameras.
The pass preserves the existing three base spray topologies and does not claim species-specific botanical reconstruction.
Static source QA cannot prove leaf-edge temporal stability, shadow dither quality, transmission balance or LOD invisibility.
Authored tree assets intentionally supersede the generated fallback and require their own rendered review if present.
